description: Fork of exp081. Single change: replace the linear unembedder with an MLP head: 224 -> LayerNorm -> Linear(224, 4*224=896) -> ReLU -> Linear(896, VOCAB). All other architecture (E=O=32, concat-prepend, per-O-chunk QK/V partitions, V2D->D2V before unembedder, H head-zone partitions on out_proj) is identical to exp081.
